                    length: (col as any).length,

    console.log("ancestor width", (foo2Ancestor as any).width, (foo2Ancestor as any).width === 13 ? "PASS" : "FAIL")
    console.log("descendant width", (foo2Descendant as any).width, (foo2Descendant as any).width === 13 ? "PASS" : "FAIL")
    console.log("ancestor precision", (foo2Ancestor as any).precision, (foo2Ancestor as any).precision === 9 ? "PASS" : "FAIL")
    console.log("descendant precision", (foo2Descendant as any).precision, (foo2Descendant as any).precision === 9 ? "PASS" : "FAIL")

    const foo3Descendant = foo3Closure.columns.find((col: any) => col.databaseName === "descendant_id")!

    console.log("descendant length", (foo3Descendant as any).length, (foo3Descendant as any).length === "201" ? "PASS" : "FAIL")

    console.log("descendant charset", (foo3Descendant as any).charset, (foo3Descendant as any).charset === "latin1" ? "PASS" : "FAIL")
    console.log("ancestor collation", (foo3Ancestor as any).collation, (foo3Ancestor as any).collation === "latin1_bin" ? "PASS" : "FAIL")
    console.log("descendant collation", (foo3Descendant as any).collation, (foo3Descendant as any).collation === "latin1_bin" ? "PASS" : "FAIL")

    const allPass = [
        (foo1Ancestor as any).unsigned === true,
        (foo1Descendant as any).unsigned === true,
        (foo2Ancestor as any).zerofill === true,
        (foo2Descendant as any).zerofill === true,
        (foo2Ancestor as any).width === 13,
        (foo2Descendant as any).width === 13,
        (foo2Ancestor as any).precision === 9,
        (foo2Descendant as any).precision === 9,
        (foo2Ancestor as any).scale === 3,
        (foo2Descendant as any).scale === 3,
        (foo3Ancestor as any).length === "201",

        (foo3Descendant as any).charset === "latin1",
        (foo3Ancestor as any).collation === "latin1_bin",
        (foo3Descendant as any).collation === "latin1_bin",
    ].every(v => v)
    console.log("\n=== OVERALL ===", allPass ? "ALL PASS" : "SOME FAIL")

    if (!allPass) process.exit(1)
}

import { DataSource } from "./src"
import { Foo1Entity as Foo1 } from "./test/functional/tree-tables/closure-table/entity/Foo1"
import { Foo2Entity as Foo2 } from "./test/functional/tree-tables/closure-table/entity/Foo2"
import { Foo3Entity as Foo3 } from "./test/functional/tree-tables/closure-table/entity/Foo3"

async function run() {
    const ds = new DataSource({
        type: "mysql",
        host: "localhost",
        port: 3306,
        username: "root",
        password: "admin",
        database: "test",
        entities: [Foo1, Foo2, Foo3],
        synchronize: false,
        logging: false,
    } as any)

    // build metadatas without connecting
    await (ds as any).buildMetadatas()

    console.log("metadatas built:", ds.entityMetadatas.length)
    for (const meta of ds.entityMetadatas) {
        console.log("table:", meta.tableName, "type:", meta.tableType, "cols:", meta.columns.map(c => `${c.databaseName}:${c.type} unsigned=${c.unsigned} zerofill=${c.zerofill} width=${c.width} precision=${c.precision} scale=${c.scale} charset=${c.charset} collation=${c.collation} length=${c.length}`).join(" | "))
        if (meta.tableName.includes("closure")) {
            console.log("  -> closure table found")
            for (const col of meta.columns) {
                console.log(`     col ${col.databaseName} prop=${col.propertyName}`, JSON.stringify({
                    unsigned: col.unsigned,
                    zerofill: col.zerofill,
                    width: col.width,
                    precision: col.precision,
                    scale: col.scale,
                    charset: col.charset,
                    collation: col.collation,
                    length: col.length,
                    type: col.type
                }))
            }
        }
    }

    function findClosure(table: string) {
        return ds.entityMetadatas.find(el => el.tableName === table)!
    }

    const foo1Closure = findClosure("foo1_closure")
    const foo1Ancestor = foo1Closure.columns.find(col => col.databaseName === "ancestor_id")!
    const foo1Descendant = foo1Closure.columns.find(col => col.databaseName === "descendant_id")!

    console.log("ancestor scale", foo2Ancestor.scale, foo2Ancestor.scale === 3 ? "PASS" : "FAIL")
    console.log("descendant scale", foo2Descendant.scale, foo2Descendant.scale === 3 ? "PASS" : "FAIL")

    const foo3Closure = findClosure("foo3_closure")
    const foo3Ancestor = foo3Closure.columns.find(col => col.databaseName === "ancestor_id")!
    const foo3Descendant = foo3Closure.columns.find(col => col.databaseName === "descendant_id")!
    console.log("\n=== Foo3 checks ===")
